## Summary

- Describe the change clearly.
- Call out any user-facing behavior or risk.

## Validation

- [ ] `node scripts/validate-repo.mjs`
- [ ] Visual test completed when UI changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or personal data were added

## Security Checklist

- [ ] New workflows use minimal permissions
- [ ] No passwords, API keys, tokens, or private keys were committed
- [ ] Sensitive configuration stays in GitHub Secrets or environment variables
